tools.name: search_tyres
tools.description: Tyres for sale, filtered by size (e.g. 205/55R16), season and brand. Returns the all-in price per tyre (incl. VAT and disposal fee), whether it can be ordered now and how fast it is available. No side effects.

tools.name: get_shop_info
tools.description: Address, opening hours, phone, delivery fee, fitting price per tyre, payment methods and links to the Terms and privacy policy. No side effects.

tools.name: list_fitting_days
tools.description: Workshop days that still have room for fitting, in the next 4 weeks. No side effects.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The exact total for these tyres and options, line by line, exactly what the payment page will charge. Checks stock and fitting capacity. Does not order, reserve, email or charge anything.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Creates an unpaid order for the given tyres and options and returns a Mollie checkoutUrl where the customer pays. Requires the customer's acceptance of the Terms (https://www.airbandenservice.com/nl/algemene-voorwaarden) and the total from get_quote; a different current total is refused. Nothing is

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Payment and order status of an order placed with place_order (by its reference, e.g. AIR-2026-…). No personal data.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote · Public sink: get_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote · Public sink: get_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
